Senior Process Automation Engineer

Salary up to $118k

Our client is a globally recognized leader in the mining and natural resources industry, supporting the production of essential materials used across infrastructure, manufacturing, technology, and the transition to cleaner energy. With large-scale operations and a strong focus on operational excellence, safety, sustainability, and innovation, the organization continues to invest in advanced technologies that improve the reliability and efficiency of its facilities.

We are seeking a Senior Process Automation Engineer
to provide technical leadership for industrial automation and control systems at a large-scale processing operation. This role will oversee the performance, reliability, security, and ongoing improvement of Industrial Control Systems while providing direction to engineering teams and supporting major automation initiatives. It is an excellent opportunity for an experienced automation professional who enjoys solving complex technical problems, influencing operational improvements, and serving as a technical leader within a highly regulated industrial environment.

Here’s what you’ll be doing:
Lead
Process Automation Engineering activities, providing technical direction, advanced troubleshooting, and guidance to engineers and other technical personnel supporting industrial control systems.
Evaluate and improve
the performance of automation hardware, software, control strategies, and related systems to increase reliability, operator effectiveness, and overall plant performance.
Oversee

Review and guide
engineering projects, technical proposals, system designs, budgets, and equipment lifecycle plans to ensure alignment with established automation, operational, safety, and cybersecurity standards.
Drive

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related discipline with 5+ years of relevant engineering experience, including at least 3 years working with regulatory and/or advanced control systems; OR a Master's degree in an appropriate Engineering discipline with 3+ years of relevant experience, including 3 years with regulatory and/or advanced control systems.

Strong knowledge of PLC, HMI, SCADA, and/or DCS technologies, with manufacturer training or certification strongly preferred.
Experience with industrial control networks, Process Control Networks, ICS cybersecurity, communications architecture, and process historians or comparable data storage and retrieval platforms.

BAS/BMS Controls Engineer

New York, NY

Our client is expanding its building controls capabilities across complex commercial and institutional environments throughout New York City and is looking for an experienced BAS/BMS Controls Engineer to play a key technical role in that growth. This is an opportunity to take ownership of sophisticated controls work from engineering and programming through startup and turnover, while working with Distech Controls, Tridium Niagara, and open-protocol building automation technologies. The right engineer will combine strong BAS design expertise with the practical field knowledge needed to turn control strategies into reliable, high-performing building systems.

This Role Offers:

Competitive base compensation, based on experience.
Exposure to technically challenging building systems and projects across New York City.
Opportunities to deepen expertise through manufacturer training and certification support.
A well-rounded employee benefits offering that supports personal well-being, financial security, and time away from work.
A collaborative environment where your controls expertise will directly support project teams, field technicians, and successful system delivery.

Focus:

Shape control architectures from mechanical plans and sequences, then translate them into dependable field-ready solutions.
Build controller logic, operator graphics, and integration strategies for sophisticated commercial HVAC environments.
Create coordinated controls submittals, drawings, and technical documentation that give project teams a clear path from design through turnover.
Support startup and commissioning by diagnosing programming, sequence, communications, and integration challenges at the engineering level.
Partner with project leadership and field technicians as the go-to engineering resource for complex BAS questions and implementation decisions.
Evaluate equipment, product, and special system requirements, helping select practical controls solutions for each application.
Contribute technical input to controls estimating and proposal development when engineering insight is needed during the preconstruction phase.
Keep final records current, including field revisions, operating documentation, and control program information, while helping train end users at turnover.

Skill Set:

Several years of directly relevant experience supporting the development and implementation of building automation or environmental control solutions within commercial settings.
Practical experience working with industry-relevant building automation technologies, platforms, and associated control systems.
Understand BACnet, Modbus, and LON communications and know how to apply automatic temperature control concepts within BAS design.
Use AutoCAD and Microsoft Visio confidently to develop controls drawings, layouts, and system documentation.
Hold a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline, or offer equivalent practical BAS/BMS design and programming expertise.
Read and interpret mechanical, electrical, and architectural drawings, specifications, equipment schedules, and sequences of operation.
Ability to reliably support on-site project needs across multiple locations within the assigned territory. An NYC SST-62 card is required by the start date or must be obtained beforehand.
Communicate clearly, organize multiple technical assignments, and work effectively with project managers, technicians, engineers, and commissioning stakeholders.

Experience building or maintaining shared component libraries or design system primitives
Experience with real-time systems or event-driven architectures as they relate to message orchestration
Experience with developer experience tooling, such as code generation, scaffolding, or CI/CD for large-scale codebases
